  • Specialized connective tissue that surrounds the umbilical cord to prevent compression

  • About ⅓ of the blood is directed away from the liver into → the ductus venosus → which connects to the IVC (inferior vena cava)
  • Closes w/ cord clamp
  • Permanent closure occurs at 3-4 weeks

Ovale → [hole in the wall]

  • Flap valve in the septum between the R & L Atria
  • Blood flows into the R atrium & 50-60% crosses the foramen ovale to the → Left Atrium
  • Usually closes 1-2 hours after birth

• Connects the pulmonary artery & the → descending aorta
  • [to bypass the lungs]
  • [can cause a murmur if not closed after birth]
